completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-22-2019-NOTIFICATION-OF-COMMENCEMTN.pdf》（1 页），本次切分 1 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en:
10th. AUGUST, 2019 I No. S 22

COMPETITION ORDER, 2015 [S 1 I20 15) Notification of commencement i In furtherance to the notification of commencement published as No. S 69 in Part I1 of the Government Gazette dated 23rd August 2017, in exercise of the power conferred by section l(1) and (2) of the Competition Order, 2015, the Minister in the Office of the Prime Minister and Minister of Finance and Economy 11, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, '~ hereby appoints 1st January 2020 as the date of commencement for the provisions ~ of that Order as set out in the Schedule hereto - i

SCHEDULE

PROVISIONS OF COMPETITION ORDER, 2015 PART I11 (Chapters 1, 2 and 6)

PART IV PART VI [sections 64 to 74)

PART V THIRD SCHEDULE (provisions in reference to section 11 prohibition) Dated this 9th. day of Zulhijjah 1440 Hijriah corresponding to the 10th. day I of August, 2019. DR. HAJAH MAY FA'EZAH BINTI HAJI AHMAD ARIFFIN Permanent Secretary, Ministry of Finance and Economy.
